HARD_BEHAVIOURAL_FALLBACK: tuple[str, ...] = (
    "Push back on impossible, contradictory, or ill-advised requirements. Say 'no' or 'I don't know' when honest. Never fabricate certainty.",
    "Default to the simplest sufficient solution. Justified complexity is complexity the user cannot do without.",
    "Do not silently comply with tangential requests. Flag them and state the priority path instead.",
    "End with a definitive stance: what was done and what comes next. Never trail off with engagement-seeking questions.",
    "Communicate as with a serious engineering colleague.",
)


def _flatten_policy_items(data: dict[str, Any], prefix: str = "policy") -> list[str]:
    """Flatten a nested TOML dict into deterministic key=value lines."""
    items: list[str] = []

    def _walk(value: Any, path: str) -> None:
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            for key in sorted(value):
                child = f"{path}.{key}" if path else key
                _walk(value[key], child)
            return
        if isinstance(value, list):
            for index, item in enumerate(value):
                _walk(item, f"{path}[{index}]")
            return
        rendered = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        items.append(f"{path}={rendered}")

    _walk(data, prefix)
    return items


def _extract_hard_behavioural_directives(universal_text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Extract the prose-only HARD behavioural directives from the universal doc."""
    import re

    section_match = re.search(
        r"##\s+Non-Formalisable Directives.*?(?=\n## |\Z)",
        universal_text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
    )
    if not section_match:
        return list(HARD_BEHAVIOURAL_FALLBACK)

    bullets: list[str] = []
    current: list[str] = []

    for raw_line in section_match.group(0).splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if line.startswith("- "):
            if current:
                bullets.append(" ".join(current))
            current = [line[2:].strip()]
        elif current and line:
            current.append(line)

    if current:
        bullets.append(" ".join(current))

    cleaned: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for bullet in bullets:
        bullet = re.sub(r"`+", "", bullet)
        bullet = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", bullet).strip().rstrip(".")
        signature = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", bullet.lower()).strip()
        if signature and signature not in seen:
            seen.add(signature)
            cleaned.append(f"{bullet}.")

    return cleaned or list(HARD_BEHAVIOURAL_FALLBACK)


def _render_universal_minimal(max_chars: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Render Layer 1 minimally while preserving every universal constraint."""
    universal_policy = _load_toml(REGISTRY_DIR / "universal.toml")

    formal_path = DIRECTIVES_DIR / "universal" / "cdsfl_core_formal.md"
    prose_path = DIRECTIVES_DIR / "universal" / "cdsfl_core.txt"
    if formal_path.exists():
        universal_text = formal_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    elif prose_path.exists():
        universal_text = prose_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        universal_text = ""

    lines = ["CDSFL CORE MINIMAL"]
    lines.extend(_flatten_policy_items(universal_policy, "policy"))

    for index, directive in enumerate(
        _extract_hard_behavioural_directives(universal_text),
        start=1,
    ):
        lines.append(f"behaviour.{index}={directive}")

    rendered = "\n".join(lines)
    if max_chars is not None and len(rendered) > max_chars:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Minimal universal directive is still too large: "
            f"{len(rendered)} chars > {max_chars}"
        )
    return rendered


def _load_universal_directive(model: str | None = None) -> DirectivePacket:
    """Load Layer 1, switching to minimal rendering when the model needs it."""
    formal_path = DIRECTIVES_DIR / "universal" / "cdsfl_core_formal.md"
    prose_path = DIRECTIVES_DIR / "universal" / "cdsfl_core.txt"

    path = formal_path if formal_path.exists() else prose_path
    full_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

    transform = PHENOTYPE_TRANSFORMS.get(model or "", PhenotypeTransform())
    use_minimal = (
        transform.format_style == "minimal"
        or len(full_text) > transform.max_directive_chars
    )
    text = (
        _render_universal_minimal(max_chars=transform.max_directive_chars)
        if use_minimal
        else full_text
    )

    return DirectivePacket(
        layer="universal",
        name="cdsfl_core",
        text=text,
        constraint_class="HARD",
        tags={"falsification", "hard_soft", "anti_deference", "verification"},
    )
```

_DIRECTIVE_START_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(?:\d+[.)]\s+|[-*•]\s+|[A-Z][A-Z0-9 _/-]+:\s*|=== .+ ===\s*)"
)

_HARD_BLOCK_MARKERS = (
    " HARD ",
    " MUST ",
    " NEVER ",
    " REQUIRED ",
    " NON-NEGOTIABLE ",
    " FORBIDDEN ",
    " DO NOT ",
    " ALWAYS ",
)


def _split_packet_directives(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Split a packet into directive-sized blocks."""
    blocks: list[str] = []
    current: list[str] = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():
        line = raw_line.rstrip()
        stripped = line.strip()

        if not stripped:
            if current:
                blocks.append("\n".join(current).strip())
                current = []
            continue

        if current and _DIRECTIVE_START_RE.match(stripped):
            blocks.append("\n".join(current).strip())
            current = [stripped]
            continue

        current.append(stripped)

    if current:
        blocks.append("\n".join(current).strip())

    return [block for block in blocks if block]


def _block_is_hard(block: str) -> bool:
    upper = f" {block.upper()} "
    return any(marker in upper for marker in _HARD_BLOCK_MARKERS)


def _prune_packet_directives(packet: DirectivePacket, max_chars: int) -> DirectivePacket:
    """Prune individual SOFT directives inside a packet to fit a character budget."""
    if len(packet.text) <= max_chars or packet.constraint_class == "HARD":
        return packet

    blocks = _split_packet_directives(packet.text)
    classified = [(block, _block_is_hard(block)) for block in blocks]

    retained = classified[:]
    while len("\n\n".join(block for block, _ in retained)) > max_chars:
        removed = False
        for index in range(len(retained) - 1, -1, -1):
            if not retained[index][1]:
                retained.pop(index)
                removed = True
                break
        if not removed:
            break  # only HARD blocks remain

    pruned_text = "\n\n".join(block for block, _ in retained).strip()
    if not pruned_text:
        pruned_text = packet.text.strip()

    return DirectivePacket(
        layer=packet.layer,
        name=packet.name,
        text=pruned_text,
        constraint_class=packet.constraint_class,
        domain=packet.domain,
        model=packet.model,
        tags=set(packet.tags),
    )
```

def _apply_phenotype_transform(text: str, transform: PhenotypeTransform) -> str:
    """Apply structural, compression, and deduplication transforms to a packet."""
    import re

    def _normalise_header(line: str) -> str:
        title = re.sub(r"^#+\s*", "", line).strip().strip(":")
        return f"{title.upper()}:" if title else ""

    def _table_row_to_line(line: str) -> str:
        cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.split("|") if cell.strip()]
        if not cells or all(set(cell) <= {"-"} for cell in cells):
            return ""
        head, *rest = cells
        return f"{head}: {'; '.join(rest)}" if rest else head

    def _semantic_tokens(block: str) -> set[str]:
        synonyms = {
            "detailed": "detail",
            "details": "detail",
            "proofs": "proof",
            "proofing": "proof",
            "minimal": "concise",
            "brief": "concise",
            "short": "concise",
            "examples": "example",
            "schemas": "schema",
        }
        stopwords = {
            "the", "and", "for", "with", "that", "this", "from", "into", "your",
            "must", "should", "would", "could", "when", "then", "than", "only",
            "use", "using", "provide", "ensure", "make", "keep", "same",
        }

        cleaned = re.sub(r"\[[^]]+\]", " ", block.lower())
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", " ", cleaned)
        tokens: set[str] = set()
        for token in cleaned.split():
            token = synonyms.get(token, token)
            if len(token) < 3 or token in stopwords:
                continue
            tokens.add(token)
        return tokens

    def _is_duplicate(block: str, kept: list[str]) -> bool:
        sig = _semantic_tokens(block)
        if not sig:
            return False

        for existing in kept:
            other = _semantic_tokens(existing)
            if not other:
                continue
            jaccard = len(sig & other) / max(len(sig | other), 1)
            containment = max(
                len(sig & other) / len(sig),
                len(sig & other) / len(other),
            )
            if jaccard >= 0.90 or containment >= 0.95:
                return True
        return False

    raw_lines = text.splitlines()
    cleaned_lines: list[str] = []
    skipping_example = False
    skipping_rationale = False

    for raw_line in raw_lines:
        stripped = raw_line.strip()
        lower = stripped.lower()

        if transform.strip_examples and lower.startswith(("example:", "examples:", "e.g.", "for example")):
            skipping_example = True
            continue
        if skipping_example:
            if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#") or _DIRECTIVE_START_RE.match(stripped):
                skipping_example = False
            else:
                continue

        if transform.strip_rationale and lower.startswith(("why:", "rationale:", "motivation:", "reason:")):
            skipping_rationale = True
            continue
        if skipping_rationale:
            if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#") or _DIRECTIVE_START_RE.match(stripped):
                skipping_rationale = False
            else:
                continue

        if not stripped:
            cleaned_lines.append("")
            continue

        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            label = _normalise_header(stripped)
            if label:
                cleaned_lines.append(label)
            continue

        if transform.compress_tables and stripped.startswith("|") and "|" in stripped:
            line = _table_row_to_line(stripped)
            if line:
                cleaned_lines.append(line)
            continue

        cleaned_lines.append(stripped)

    blocks: list[list[str]] = []
    current: list[str] = []

    for line in cleaned_lines:
        if not line:
            if current:
                blocks.append(current)
                current = []
            continue
        if current and _DIRECTIVE_START_RE.match(line):
            blocks.append(current)
            current = [line]
            continue
        current.append(line)

    if current:
        blocks.append(current)

    collapsed: list[str] = []
    for block in blocks:
        first = block[0]
        if first.endswith(":") and len(block) > 1:
            collapsed.append(f"{first} {' '.join(block[1:])}")
        else:
            collapsed.append(" ".join(block))

    deduped: list[str] = []
    for block in collapsed:
        block = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", block).strip()
        if not block:
            continue
        if not _is_duplicate(block, deduped):
            deduped.append(block)

    rendered = "\n".join(deduped).strip()
    if len(rendered) <= transform.max_directive_chars:
        return rendered

    kept: list[str] = []
    total = 0
    for block in deduped:
        extra = len(block) + (1 if kept else 0)
        if total + extra > transform.max_directive_chars:
            break
        kept.append(block)
        total += extra

    return "\n".join(kept).strip()

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DirectiveConflict:
    winner_layer: str
    loser_layer: str
    winner_text: str
    loser_text: str
    reason: str


_LAYER_PRIORITY = {
    "universal": 4,
    "domain": 3,
    "phenotype": 2,
    "situation": 1,
}


def _directive_topics(text: str) -> set[str]:
    import re

    aliases = {
        "detailed": "verbosity",
        "detail": "verbosity",
        "proof": "proof",
        "proofs": "proof",
        "minimal": "verbosity",
        "concise": "verbosity",
        "brief": "verbosity",
        "format": "format",
        "schema": "format",
        "json": "format",
        "verify": "verification",
        "verification": "verification",
    }
    stopwords = {
        "the", "and", "for", "with", "that", "this", "from", "into", "your",
        "must", "should", "would", "could", "when", "then", "than", "only",
        "use", "using", "provide", "ensure", "make", "keep",
    }

    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", " ", text.lower())
    topics: set[str] = set()
    for token in cleaned.split():
        token = aliases.get(token, token)
        if len(token) < 3 or token in stopwords:
            continue
        topics.add(token)

    lower = text.lower()
    if any(phrase in lower for phrase in ("detailed", "detail", "step by step", "full proof", "minimal", "concise", "brief")):
        topics.add("verbosity")

    return topics


def _directive_polarity(text: str) -> str:
    lower = text.lower()
    if any(phrase in lower for phrase in ("do not", "don't", "never", "avoid", "forbid", "forbidden", "must not")):
        return "negative"
    if any(phrase in lower for phrase in ("minimal", "concise", "brief", "short")):
        return "negative"
    return "positive"


def _directive_specificity(packet: DirectivePacket, text: str) -> int:
    score = len(_directive_topics(text))
    if packet.domain:
        score += 2
    if packet.model:
        score += 2
    if packet.layer == "situation":
        score += 1
    return score


def _directives_conflict(left: str, right: str) -> bool:
    overlap = _directive_topics(left) & _directive_topics(right)
    if not overlap:
        return False
    return _directive_polarity(left) != _directive_polarity(right)


def resolve_packet_conflicts(composed: ComposedDirectiveSet) -> ComposedDirectiveSet:
    """Resolve directive conflicts across layers and log the decisions."""
    kept: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    conflicts: list[DirectiveConflict] = []

    for packet_index, packet in enumerate(composed.packets):
        directives = _split_packet_directives(packet.text)
        for directive_index, directive in enumerate(directives):
            current = {
                "packet_index": packet_index,
                "directive_index": directive_index,
                "packet": packet,
                "text": directive,
            }
            rejected = False

            for prior in list(kept):
                if not _directives_conflict(current["text"], prior["text"]):
                    continue

                current_rank = (
                    1 if packet.constraint_class == "HARD" else 0,
                    _LAYER_PRIORITY.get(packet.layer, 0),
                    _directive_specificity(packet, current["text"]),
                    -directive_index,
                )
                prior_packet = prior["packet"]
                prior_rank = (
                    1 if prior_packet.constraint_class == "HARD" else 0,
                    _LAYER_PRIORITY.get(prior_packet.layer, 0),
                    _directive_specificity(prior_packet, prior["text"]),
                    -prior["directive_index"],
                )

                if current_rank > prior_rank:
                    kept.remove(prior)
                    conflicts.append(
                        DirectiveConflict(
                            winner_layer=packet.layer,
                            loser_layer=prior_packet.layer,
                            winner_text=current["text"],
                            loser_text=prior["text"],
                            reason="hard/layer/specificity precedence",
                        )
                    )
                else:
                    conflicts.append(
                        DirectiveConflict(
                            winner_layer=prior_packet.layer,
                            loser_layer=packet.layer,
                            winner_text=prior["text"],
                            loser_text=current["text"],
                            reason="hard/layer/specificity precedence",
                        )
                    )
                    rejected = True
                    break

            if not rejected:
                kept.append(current)

    regrouped: dict[int, list[str]] = {i: [] for i in range(len(composed.packets))}
    for item in kept:
        regrouped[item["packet_index"]].append(item["text"])

    resolved_packets: list[DirectivePacket] = []
    for index, packet in enumerate(composed.packets):
        new_text = "\n\n".join(regrouped[index]).strip()
        if new_text:
            resolved_packets.append(
                DirectivePacket(
                    layer=packet.layer,
                    name=packet.name,
                    text=new_text,
                    constraint_class=packet.constraint_class,
                    domain=packet.domain,
                    model=packet.model,
                    tags=set(packet.tags),
                )
            )
        elif packet.constraint_class == "HARD":
            resolved_packets.append(packet)

    rendered = _render_directive_text(resolved_packets)
    model = str(composed.manifest.get("model", "unknown"))
    cid = _compute_cid(resolved_packets, model)
    token_estimate = max(len(rendered) // 4, 1)
    density = composed.constraint_count / token_estimate

    manifest = dict(composed.manifest)
    manifest["cid"] = cid
    manifest["conflicts"] = [
        {
            "winner_layer": c.winner_layer,
            "loser_layer": c.loser_layer,
            "winner_text": c.winner_text,
            "loser_text": c.loser_text,
            "reason": c.reason,
        }
        for c in conflicts
    ]

    return ComposedDirectiveSet(
        packets=resolved_packets,
        rendered_text=rendered,
        policy=composed.policy,
        cid=cid,
        constraint_count=composed.constraint_count,
        token_estimate=token_estimate,
        constraint_density=density,
        coherence_budget=composed.coherence_budget,
        pruned_soft=list(composed.pruned_soft),
        manifest=manifest,
    )

def calibrate_coherence_budgets(
    log_paths: list[str | Path],
    *,
    constraint_count_by_model: dict[str, int] | None = None,
    min_points_per_model: int = 3,
    density_round_digits: int = 4,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Calibrate per-model coherence thresholds from experiment logs.

    Threshold rule:
    - Compute finding quality = findings / 1000 response tokens.
    - Bucket runs by directive density.
    - Find the peak mean quality per model.
    - Return the smallest density above the peak where mean quality drops
      by more than 10% from peak.
    """
    from collections import defaultdict
    import statistics
    import re

    def _load_record(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def _model_name(record: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        model = (
            record.get("model")
            or record.get("model_label")
            or record.get("metadata", {}).get("model")
        )
        if not model:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing model field in record: {record.keys()}")
        return str(model)

    def _response_chars(record: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        return int(
            record.get("chars")
            or record.get("response_length")
            or len(record.get("response", ""))
        )

    def _finding_count(record: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        metadata = record.get("metadata", {})
        if isinstance(metadata.get("findings_count"), int):
            return metadata["findings_count"]

        response = record.get("response", "")
        patterns = (
            r"(?mi)^FINDING_ID\s*:",
            r"(?mi)^Finding ID\s*:",
            r"(?mi)^PROBLEM\s+\d+\s+SOLUTION:",
        )
        counts = [len(re.findall(pattern, response)) for pattern in patterns]
        best = max(counts) if counts else 0
        return best if best > 0 else (1 if response.strip() else 0)

    def _density(record: dict[str, Any], model: str) -> float:
        metadata = record.get("metadata", {})

        for key in ("constraint_density", "density", "coherence_density"):
            value = metadata.get(key, record.get(key))
            if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and value > 0:
                return float(value)

        constraint_count = metadata.get("constraint_count")
        if constraint_count is None and constraint_count_by_model is not None:
            constraint_count = constraint_count_by_model.get(model)

        directive_chars = (
            metadata.get("directive_chars")
            or metadata.get("system_prompt_chars")
            or metadata.get("prompt_chars")
            or record.get("prompt_length")
        )

        if constraint_count is None or directive_chars is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Cannot derive density for model={model}. "
                f"Need constraint_density directly, or constraint_count plus directive chars."
            )

        return float(constraint_count) / max(int(directive_chars) // 4, 1)

    buckets: dict[str, dict[float, list[float]]] = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))

    for path in log_paths:
        record = _load_record(path)
        model = _model_name(record)
        density = round(_density(record, model), density_round_digits)

        response_tokens = max(_response_chars(record) // 4, 1)
        findings = _finding_count(record)
        quality = findings / (response_tokens / 1000.0)

        buckets[model][density].append(quality)

    thresholds: dict[str, float] = {}

    for model, density_map in buckets.items():
        if sum(len(values) for values in density_map.values()) < min_points_per_model:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Insufficient calibration data for {model}: "
                f"{sum(len(values) for values in density_map.values())} points"
            )

        mean_quality = {
            density: statistics.fmean(values)
            for density, values in density_map.items()
        }
        ordered = sorted(mean_quality.items())

        peak_density, peak_quality = max(
            ordered,
            key=lambda item: (item[1], -item[0]),
        )
        cutoff = peak_quality * 0.90

        drop_candidates = [
            density
            for density, quality in ordered
            if density > peak_density and quality < cutoff
        ]

        thresholds[model] = (
            drop_candidates[0]
            if drop_candidates
            else ordered[-1][0]
        )

    return thresholds
